title: Late missing-item report after a documented hospitalization
facts_text: My order was delivered 60 hours ago, and the main dish was missing. I was unexpectedly hospitalized and could not report it sooner; I can provide documentation of the hospitalization. The order records support that the main dish was not delivered. I do not have a photo because the dish never arrived.
request: Can you refund the missing main dish and its tax?

strict.reason: The report was made after the 48-hour deadline, and the strict variant permits no deadline extension.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The report is within 72 hours; documented unforeseen hospitalization prevented an earlier report, and order records support the missing item.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The policy permits an agent to consider an extension in exceptional circumstances but does not define the criteria; approval is discretionary.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Confirm the case falls within the exception's 48-to-72-hour window and that the facts establish every stated eligibility condition. The missing-item policy explicitly says a photo is not required when unavailable.
